ideas.title: Following the Money: Uncovering the Impact of Federal Funding Freezes
ideas.description: Investigate the effects of the Trump administration's federal funding freezes on various projects and programs
questions: What projects are being affected by the funding freezes?
What are the motivations behind these funding decisions?
ideas.insight: This story idea has the potential to uncover a large-scale pattern of corruption and abuse of power. By following the money, we can determine which projects are being affected and why.
